    • checkAlerts

      public void checkAlerts()
      Checks all alerts in the database and sends notifications to users if the current price of the cryptocurrency exceeds their specified price threshold or if the price change percentage exceeds their specified variation threshold. This method retrieves all alerts, iterates through each alert, and checks the current price and change percentage of the associated cryptocurrency. If the conditions are met, it sends an email notification to the user.
